Improving Ways of Working

How do I identify opportunities for automation?

Short Answer

Look for stable, repetitive steps and assess their value, risks and exceptions before choosing an approved automation approach.

Detailed Guidance

Look for frequent, rule-based tasks with predictable inputs and outputs, then quantify the time or service improvement an automation could deliver. Check exceptions, data quality, privacy, security and maintenance needs, and use your agency's approval and governance process before building or deploying it.
